name: Sync-Tech System Corp
summary: Sync-Tech System Corp. engages in the manufacture and sale of panel and automotive liquid crystal display (LCD) driver semiconductor test probe cards in Taiwan and China. It offers LCD driver semiconductor probe cards and printed circuit board design services, as well as repair services. Its products are used in TVs, laptops, mobile phones, e-paper, display screens and other related products. The company was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Zhubei, Taiwan.
